name: auto-tab-switcher
description: Automatically switches to the next tab every few seconds

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:settings
scripts.build:dev: npm run clean && BUILD_PREMIUM=true BUILD_TYPE=development node scripts/generate-build-config.js && npm run _internal:compile
scripts.build:prod:free: npm run clean && BUILD_PREMIUM=false BUILD_TYPE=production-free node scripts/generate-build-config.js && npm run _internal:compile && npm run _internal:build-settings && npm run _internal:minify
scripts.build:prod:premium: npm run clean && BUILD_PREMIUM=true BUILD_TYPE=production-premium node scripts/generate-build-config.js && npm run _internal:compile && npm run _internal:build-settings && npm run _internal:minify
